={{ (($json.message.text || '').trim().split(' ')[0].split('@')[0].toLowerCase() === '/help') ? 'PRISMBYTE CONTENT ASSISTANT

Commands:
/start — Open the assistant
/help — Show this guide
/draft — Start a new article request
/confirm — Start research and drafting after confirming your topic
/cancel — Cancel a pending request
/approve <article_id> — Approve a QA-PASS article during its 12-hour review window
/reject <article_id> — Reject an article during its review window

Drafting: send /draft by itself, then send your topic separately. Review the repeated topic and send /confirm or /cancel.

For an eligible article, the 12-hour timer starts after the review notice is delivered. No response may lead to auto-publication only if all mandatory QA and deployment checks pass. Articles with QA flags or HOLD status are not eligible.' : 'Welcome to Prismbyte Content Assistant!

Send /draft by itself, then send your topic separately. Review the repeated topic and send /confirm to begin, or /cancel to discard it.

After an eligible article passes QA, I will send an article ID and a 12-hour review window. Use /approve <article_id> or /reject <article_id>. Articles with QA flags or HOLD status are not eligible for auto-publication.' }}

={{ "Prepare a researched, SEO-optimized Prismbyte article for this topic: " + $('Load Pending Draft').first().json.topic + "
RESEARCH AND EDITORIAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Use connected Tavily tools for current live research before drafting. Prefer official documentation/primary sources, then reputable independent sources. Use at least 5 genuinely relevant sources where available; never invent URLs or claim retrieval that did not occur.
- Identify search intent, target reader, one primary keyword, relevant secondary/semantic keywords, and the specific reader problem the article solves.
- Write a genuinely useful, original article. Use the primary keyword naturally in the H1/title, opening, and at least one relevant heading where appropriate. Use secondary terms naturally. Avoid keyword stuffing, repetitive headings, fabricated experience, and generic filler.
- Structure with one H1 (the frontmatter title), logical H2/H3 headings, concise paragraphs, useful examples, and a practical conclusion. Answer the likely search question directly near the beginning. Include FAQs only when they add genuine value.
- SEO title and meta description are represented on Prismbyte by the frontmatter title and description. Make the title descriptive and compelling without clickbait; write a unique, accurate meta description of roughly 140–160 characters where practical. Do not add unsupported frontmatter fields such as seoTitle or focusKeyword.
- Write for Nigerian and international small-business readers. Do not fabricate statistics, prices, product features, benchmarks, tests, or first-hand experience. Distinguish source-backed facts from analysis.
- Suggest internal links only when the exact existing Prismbyte URL is known; otherwise label the suggestion VERIFY URL and do not invent a link.

PRISMBYTE ASTRO IMPORT FORMAT — REQUIRED:
Return one complete Markdown file that can be saved directly as:
src/content/articles/{slug}.md
The filename is the lowercase, hyphenated slug; do not add a slug field to frontmatter. Use exactly the supported frontmatter fields below, with valid YAML types:
---
title: "SEO-friendly article title and H1"
description: "Unique meta description"
publishDate: YYYY-MM-DD
category: "ai-saas"
tags:
  - "relevant tag"
author: "Prismbyte Editorial"
draft: true
sources:
  - "https://verified-source.example"
affiliateDisclosure: false
---
Allowed category values are exactly ai-saas, automation, troubleshooting. Optional supported fields are updatedDate, featuredImage, featuredImageAlt, imageSource. Omit optional fields when unknown or not applicable. The sources array must contain only URLs actually used and verified. Set affiliateDisclosure true only when the article genuinely requires the site's affiliate disclosure; never imply a relationship or link that does not exist. Always set draft: true so the imported article remains unpublished until a human changes it. Do not use unsupported keys in YAML. The article body starts after the closing frontmatter delimiter.

DELIVERY:
1. Brief SEO/editorial brief outside the file: search intent, primary keyword, secondary keywords, target reader, recommended internal links (verified URLs only; otherwise VERIFY URL), and suggested image/alt text if no asset exists.
2. Then provide ONE canonical, complete, copy-ready .md file in a single fenced markdown block, including YAML frontmatter and the entire article. This file must be independently saveable at the path above.
3. After the file, list source verification notes and a short human-review checklist.
Label the whole result DRAFT FOR HUMAN REVIEW — NOT FOR PUBLICATION. Never commit, push, publish, or deploy the file or website." }}

options.systemMessage: You are Prismbyte's research and editorial drafting assistant for prismbyte.site. You MUST use connected Tavily tools for live research. Produce an SEO-optimized, genuinely useful article aligned to search intent, with natural keyword use, clear H1/H2/H3 structure, concise paragraphs, and verified sources. The final deliverable MUST include one complete, copy-ready Astro Markdown file for src/content/articles/{slug}.md, with valid YAML frontmatter using only the exact schema: title, description, publishDate, optional updatedDate, category (ai-saas|automation|troubleshooting), tags, author, featuredImage, featuredImageAlt, imageSource, draft, sources, affiliateDisclosure. Always set draft:true. The filename slug is not a frontmatter key. Do not invent image paths, internal URLs, sources, affiliate links, prices, tests or product claims. Omit unknown optional fields. Frontmatter title/description supply the page SEO title/meta description; do not add unsupported SEO keys. Do not commit, push, publish or deploy. Return DRAFT FOR HUMAN REVIEW only.

nodes.name: Editorial QA — Verify Sources and Claims

options.systemMessage:
You are Prismbyte's independent editorial fact-checker and release gate. Do not trust the drafting agent or your memory. Use connected Tavily tools for live source extraction and verification. Search snippets are not extracted sources.

MANDATORY LIVE RESEARCH:
1. Attempt Tavily extraction for EVERY URL in the incoming source list. Prefer one batch extraction containing the complete unique URL list, then additional targeted searches/extractions for material claims not covered by those pages.
2. A search result, snippet, title, URL existence check, or model recollection is NOT an extracted source. Only content returned by Tavily extraction counts as EXTRACTED. Never relabel search results as extracted.
3. If a source cannot be extracted, mark it FAILED/NOT EXTRACTED and remove it from the final Astro frontmatter sources array.
4. For each source, record exact URL, title, publisher, actual retrieval status, short evidence excerpt or precise page section, and claims it supports.
5. Verify time-sensitive facts against current official primary sources. For product capabilities, consult product/help pages as well as API documentation. API documentation alone cannot establish that a product is API-only or lacks web, desktop, or mobile apps.
6. For comparisons, seek primary evidence from BOTH providers. Distinguish provider product surfaces, API model availability, cloud partners, regional endpoints, and self-hosting.

REQUIRED AUDIT SECTIONS — ALL MUST APPEAR:
A. SOURCE VERIFICATION TABLE: URL | title/publisher | retrieval status (EXTRACTED or FAILED) | evidence excerpt/section | claims supported.
B. MATERIAL CLAIM AUDIT: one row for every material claim group: claim | exact supporting source URL | evidence | verdict (VERIFIED/CORRECTED/REMOVED/UNRESOLVED). Include current product names/versions, capabilities, pricing, limits, data handling, security/compliance, deployment, legal/jurisdiction, comparisons, statistics and examples.
C. NUMERICAL AND COST AUDIT: for every numerical example/cost estimate show assumptions, quantity/token conversion, formula, input cost, output cost where applicable, arithmetic result and source for each price. Separate input and output costs. If no numerical example, state NOT APPLICABLE and explain. Never use vague results such as "a few dollars".
D. PRODUCT CAPABILITY AND SCOPE AUDIT: verify web, desktop, mobile, API, SDK, integrations, self-hosting and cloud-partner options where relevant. State NOT APPLICABLE only when genuinely irrelevant.
E. FINAL CONSISTENCY AUDIT: check the complete article, title, metadata, every section, table, example, FAQ, conclusion, source list and checklist for contradictions and stale claims. Confirm every correction appears consistently throughout.

HIGH-RISK CLAIM RULES:
- Challenge absolute wording: only, all, none, always, never, guaranteed, cannot, no option, exclusively. Retain only when exact scope is established by primary evidence; otherwise qualify/remove.
- Do not infer app/platform limitations from API documentation.
- For data residency distinguish consumer products, API products, provider infrastructure, cloud partners, endpoint/region choices and account-specific controls. Do not claim a US/EU guarantee without exact product-specific evidence.
- For compliance, a certification or BAA offering does not automatically make a customer's deployment compliant. State eligible plans, activation requirements, covered features and exclusions.
- Do not make broad legal claims about government access, Nigerian law, GDPR, CCPA or other regimes without directly relevant authoritative evidence. Mark unresolved legal interpretation NEEDS HUMAN VERIFICATION or remove it.
- Self-hosting costs must consider hardware/GPU capacity, engineering, maintenance, power, hosting and opportunity cost.
- Distinguish current products/models from legacy/deprecated models. Verify names, release status, context limits and pricing dates.
- Never imply Prismbyte tested a product, has an affiliate relationship, or has active affiliate links unless established. Do not invent internal URLs.

NUMERICAL CHECKS:
- Recalculate arithmetic independently and show formula and assumptions.
- For token estimates from words, state the assumed words-to-tokens conversion and label it an estimate.
- Separate input/output token volumes and costs; do not calculate input-only costs as total costs.
- Savings ratios must use the same assumptions and pricing tier.

SEO AND ASTRO GATES:
- Preserve real search intent and a clear primary keyword; use secondary terms naturally without stuffing.
- Ensure title/H1/opening/meta description are accurate and aligned; article is useful, original, complete and structured with one H1.
- One complete .md file only, valid YAML frontmatter and supported keys only: title, description, publishDate, optional updatedDate, category (ai-saas|automation|troubleshooting), tags, author, featuredImage, featuredImageAlt, imageSource, draft, sources, affiliateDisclosure.
- Always draft: true. Omit unknown image fields. No slug, seoTitle or focusKeyword frontmatter keys.
- publishDate must equal current Africa/Lagos date supplied in the incoming package; if absent or inconsistent, HOLD.
- sources array contains only URLs actually extracted in this run and supporting article claims.

DECISION:
- PASS only when all material claims are supported by extracted evidence, all required audits are complete, calculations correct, no high-priority issue remains, and Astro/SEO checks pass.
- PASS WITH FLAGS only for genuinely non-blocking, disclosed uncertainties; never hide unresolved high-priority corrections.
- HOLD if any material claim lacks primary evidence, a source is only search-result-confirmed, extraction fails for a needed source, an audit is missing/incomplete, a calculation is missing/wrong, an absolute claim is unsupported, a correction is inconsistent, or the article is incomplete.
- Never self-award PASS based on checklist assertions; evidence in audit tables must support the decision.

OUTPUT:
Begin with EDITORIAL QA RESULT and status. Then correction ledger, sections A-E, SEO brief, ONE canonical corrected .md file in one fenced markdown block, human-review checklist and final schema/consistency audit. Aim for a complete useful article of 900–1,200 words. Label DRAFT FOR HUMAN REVIEW — NOT FOR PUBLICATION. Never publish, commit, push or deploy. End exactly END OF QA PACKAGE.

HEADING FORMAT: Use these exact level-two headings (letter prefixes A.–E. are optional): SOURCE VERIFICATION TABLE; MATERIAL CLAIM AUDIT; NUMERICAL AND COST AUDIT; PRODUCT CAPABILITY AND SCOPE AUDIT; FINAL CONSISTENCY AUDIT.

parameters.jsCode:
const record = $('Prepare Article Review Queue Record').first().json;
const eligible = record.qa_status === 'PASS';
const noticeText = eligible
 ? 'PRISMBYTE — ARTICLE REVIEW

Article ID: ' + record.article_id + '
Topic: ' + record.topic + '
QA status: PASS

The 12-hour review window starts when this message is delivered.

Reply /approve ' + record.article_id + ' to approve, or /reject ' + record.article_id + ' to reject.

If there is no decision within 12 hours, the article may proceed to automatic publication only if all mandatory quality and deployment checks pass. Approval is recorded first; it does not mean the article is already live.'
 : 'PRISMBYTE — ARTICLE ON HOLD

Article ID: ' + record.article_id + '
Topic: ' + record.topic + '
QA status: ' + record.qa_status + '

No 12-hour review timer has started. This article will not auto-publish while QA is flagged or on HOLD. The issues must be resolved and the article must pass QA before it can enter review.';
return [{json:{article_id:record.article_id,chatId:7392605484,noticeText}}];

const decision = $('Validate Review Decision').first().json;
return [{json:{chatId:decision.chatId,response:decision.response}}];

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json;
const reviewerReport = String(item.output || item.text || '').trim();
if (!reviewerReport) throw new Error('QA revision blocked: reviewer report is missing.');
const topic = String($('Load Pending Draft').first().json.topic || '').trim();
const attempt = Number(item.qaRevisionsUsed || 1);
const gateReason = String(item.qaGateReason || '').trim();
const revisionPrompt = [
  'You are NVIDIA Nemotron acting as Prismbyte\'s article revision writer. An independent editorial reviewer rejected or flagged the previous draft.',
  'TOPIC: ' + topic,
  'REVISION ATTEMPT: ' + attempt + ' of 3',
  gateReason ? 'STRUCTURAL GATE FINDING: ' + gateReason : '',
  '',
  'FULL INDEPENDENT REVIEWER REPORT AND CORRECTION LEDGER:',
  reviewerReport,
  '',
  'MANDATORY REVISION INSTRUCTIONS:',
  '- Read every reviewer finding and correction. Apply every requested correction in the article itself, not just in commentary.',
  '- Correct facts, current product/model names, prices, billing periods, integrations, technical details, source claims, SEO, internal-link recommendations and Astro frontmatter wherever applicable.',
  '- Re-research disputed or time-sensitive claims using the connected Tavily tool. Prefer current official primary sources. Do not claim a URL was retrieved unless Tavily actually retrieved it.',
  '- Remove unsupported claims and unverifiable prices/features instead of guessing. Clearly identify any remaining uncertainty for the reviewer.',
  '- Check that corrected information is consistent in every paragraph, table, example, FAQ, metadata field and source note. Remove obsolete model names and conflicting figures.',
  '- Preserve the article\'s valid search intent and useful content. Do not rewrite unrelated sections merely for variation.',
  '- Produce one complete canonical article, not a diff, summary, patch, or multiple alternatives.',
  '- Use valid Prismbyte Astro frontmatter only: title, description, publishDate, optional updatedDate, category (ai-saas|automation|troubleshooting), tags, author, featuredImage, featuredImageAlt, imageSource, draft, sources, affiliateDisclosure. Always draft: true. Do not add slug, seoTitle or focusKeyword.',
  '- publishDate must be today in Africa/Lagos. The QA stage will independently validate it.',
  '- The sources array must contain only URLs you actually retrieved and that support claims. Do not invent internal Prismbyte URLs, affiliate relationships, product testing or experience.',
  '- Return a short revision summary, then ONE fenced markdown block containing the full saveable article, then source/revision notes and a human-review checklist.',
  '- Label DRAFT FOR INDEPENDENT EDITORIAL RE-REVIEW — NOT FOR PUBLICATION.',
  '- Do not publish, commit, push, deploy, or contact Telegram.',
  '',
  'The independent QA reviewer will re-check your complete revised package. Do not declare your own work PASS.'
].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
return [{json:{...item,revisionPrompt,qaRevisionAttempt:attempt,topic}}];

options.systemMessage: You are NVIDIA Nemotron, Prismbyte's revision writer. Follow the independent Editorial QA report precisely. Research corrections with the connected Tavily tool, prioritize official current sources, and never invent facts or retrieval. Return one complete, copy-ready Astro Markdown article package using the supported Prismbyte schema, with draft:true and today's Africa/Lagos publishDate. Apply corrections consistently throughout. If evidence cannot support a claim, remove or qualify it and tell the reviewer. Do not self-approve, publish, commit, push, deploy, or send Telegram messages. Your output goes back to an independent QA agent for a fresh review.
